annotation.title_clean: 国家林业和草原局 国家发展和改革委员会 财政部 自然资源部关于印发《林业草原保护利用“十五五”规划》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, NDRC, Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Natural Resources on Issuing the 15th Five-Year Plan for Forest and Grassland Protection and Utilization
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家林业和草原局; 国家发展和改革委员会; 财政部; 自然资源部
annotation.summary_en: China's 15th Five-Year Plan (2026–2030) for forest and grassland protection and utilization, issued by four central bodies. It covers afforestation, protected areas, forestry industry, fire and pest control, reform and international cooperation. AI and drones appear only in passing, as digitalization and low-altitude economy applications.
key_provisions_or_claims: Win the Three-North shelterbelt programme campaigns by 2030
Build a national park-based protected area system
Develop forestry industry and forest food supply
Launch 'AI+ forestry and grassland' action and integrated monitoring
Strengthen forest-grass rule of law and the forest chief system
